pages.visualNorthStar: File upload area + route classification results + KPI cards + rate calculations in a clean table.

pages.visualNorthStar: Two-file upload (opportunity + browsing), match results table, deal amount summary, wake-cycle badge.

pages.title: 商机分配
pages.visualNorthStar: Upload assignment sheet, display pending distribution list with advisor assignment dropdowns.

pages.title: 顾问转化排名

pages.compositionPattern: filter bar + add button + card grid

pages.title: 社群日历
pages.visualNorthStar: Week view calendar with daily content slots, editable post copy, linked asset titles.
pages.compositionPattern: week calendar + day columns + content cards

pages.title: 社群活动
pages.visualNorthStar: Activity list + tabs for planning template / registration / review / ROI.

pages.title: 积分激励
pages.visualNorthStar: Weekly points leaderboard with source breakdown and redemption placeholder.
